_comment: Small FIXED golden corpus for the retrieval regression guard (eval/check_regression.py). 'easy' queries: every stack must rank the answer first. 'lexical' probes: the answer hinges on a rare exact token (code, number, surname variant) among near-duplicates worded closer to the query; dense MiniLM ranks it 2nd-3rd, BM25 finds it, so only Hybrid ranks it first. 'entity' probes: the answer names the query's person (spaCy entity) while same-surname distractors are semantically closer; only Graph's entity boost ranks it first. Hence distinct baselines below 1.0 and a guard that notices when BM25 or the entity boost breaks (--self-test). Do NOT edit without re-running --self-test and regenerating eval/baselines.json (python -m eval.check_regression --update).

docs.text: Marie Curie was a physicist and chemist who conducted pioneering research on radioactivity. She remains the only person to win Nobel Prizes in two different sciences, Physics and Chemistry.
